title: bare cairn codemother harbor_master prints the boat count
intention: Bare `cairn codemother harbor_master` prints one line, "N boats (x open, y in port)", from the fleet register's counts, as outline 9.4.1.5 names it.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 under a scratch HOME: bare `cairn codemother harbor_master` prints the base shim's 'device: harbor_master / class: cairn/devices/harbor_master/' (cairn/tools/base/shim.py:1252), a path that no longer exists; outline 9.4.1.5 COMMANDS names "652 boats (570 open, 82 in port)".
traces_to: Law 9 (the outline names the answer) and Law 7 (a presentation surface stays coherent with its record).
how: HarborMasterShim overrides _bare() (the one bare hook, 59f7456dd9f5): it ensures the device, reads the fleet map's counts and returns exit 0 with '<open+in_port> boats (<open> open, <in_port> in port)'. A new proof drives the bare command and the shim hook.
